name: 08-stall-triage
about: Six weeks of an upper/lower strength block at Standard tracking: bench and squat flat for the last three exposures with 92 % adherence, good sleep, and a week that felt flat.

adherence.why: The 4 complete weeks 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-22 planned 12 lifting sessions; 11 are logged. The Friday 2026-03-13 session was ticked as trained but not logged and not marked, so it counts as unlogged: 11/12 = 92 %, a lower bound.

stall.why: Bench best-of-3 e1RM 98.67 against 98.17 three exposures back: +0.51 %, at most 2 %, with 92 % adherence (80 % needed): a stall, inside the noise band (plateau).
Squat alternates 102.5 x 5 and x 6; best-of-3 stays at 123.0, a 0 % change: stalled.

triage.why: Step 1 does not apply: sleep 7.47 h a night over the last 7 days (7 needed), readiness normal, protein 1.8 g/kg. Step 2 applies and is chosen: recovery 2/5 last week is a fatigue sign and the scheduled deload is 2 weeks away. Step 3 (rep range or variation at the boundary) always applies; step 4 applies too (poor recovery: chest 6 sets down 2), but one step per check-in.

deload.why: Plan week 6 of a 4-week rhythm: the scheduled deload is week 8. Stalls on two main lifts (bench and squat) trigger an early deload offer this week.
